g.text: The Coordination Service's Own Replica Cluster
5 replicas, one elected leader, a majority quorum on every write -- and client sessions connecting in from outside.
Majority (3 of 5) must acknowledge before a write commits
Consensus among the service's OWN replicas -- who's the leader, what's committed -- is a different
question from the coordination PRIMITIVES offered to clients (locks, leader election), built on top.
